§ 18.43 Consolidation; separate hearings.
§ 18.43 Consolidation; separate hearings.
(a) 
Consolidation.
(1) Join for hearing any or all matters at issue in the proceedings;

(2) Consolidate the proceedings; or

(3) Issue any other orders to avoid unnecessary cost or delay.

(b) 
Separate hearings.
